message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s). Facts: Defendant bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) which are state-protected (三级文物). He purchased from another person, intending to resell for profit. He also defrauded victim of 5 million RMB by promising high profit from selling artifacts, got money, used for other purposes, partially returned 1 million and gave low-value artifacts. So crimes: (1) Illegal trade of cultural relics (illegal possession/ trafficking of cultural relics). In Chinese law, crimes: "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal buying and selling of cultural relics) or "非法买卖文物罪" (selling prohibited cultural relics). Also "诈骗罪" (fraud). The prosecution says "构成××和诈骗罪". So need to output both: illegal trade of cultural relics; fraud. In examples, they sometimes phrase as "走私国家禁止进出口的货物、物品". For cultural relics, typical label: "非法买卖文物罪". Could be "非法买卖文物". Also could be "非法买卖文物罪". The answer format: [罪名]...;...<eoa>. Use Chinese terms.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法买卖文物;诈骗<eoa>

Check mistakes: avoid mislabeling as "诈骗" only. Should include both. Ensure correct ordering? Not important.
